rising.title: Suppressing Primer-Driven Nonspecific Amplification in LAMP Using TrueLAMP
rising.title_zh: 使用 TrueLAMP 抑制 LAMP 中引物驱动的非特异性扩增
rising.summary_zh: 环介导等温扩增（LAMP）能够实现快速核酸检测，但易受引物驱动的非特异性扩增影响，可能产生假阳性结果。我们开发了 TrueLAMP，一种比色 LAMP 配方，包含一种抑制剂，可抑制非特异性扩增，同时保留靶标依赖性扩增。这些研究中的所有 65 个无模板对照均保持阴性，对应 100% 的观察特异性。使用 SARS-CoV-2 作为模型和 Lamb 引物组作为代表性基准，TrueLAMP 实现了每反应 250 拷贝的检测限，检测概率为 95%。终点颜色在延长孵育期间保持稳定，减少了对时间关键读出的需求。TrueLAMP 与现成的加热设备兼容，包括对流烤箱、水浴和温控智能杯。两个外部实验室使用额外引物-模板系统（包括 DNA 靶标）的独立评估进一步支持抑制非特异性扩增和序列依赖性靶标检测。总之，这些发现支持 TrueLAMP 作为提高 LAMP 检测可靠性同时保持简单等温工作流程的实用方法。

extra.description: Loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) enables rapid nucleic acid detection but is vulnerable to primer-driven nonspecific amplification that can produce false-positive results. We developed TrueLAMP, a colorimetric LAMP formulation containing an inhibitor that suppresses nonspecific amplification while preserving target-dependent amplification. All 65 no-template controls across these studies remained negative, corresponding to 100% observed specificity. Using SARS-CoV-2 as a model and the Lamb primer set as a representative benchmark, TrueLAMP achieved a limit of detection of 250 copies per reaction with 95% detection probability. Endpoint color remained stable during extended incubation, reducing the need for time-critical readout. TrueLAMP was compatible with readily available heating devices, including a convection oven, water bath, and temperature-controlled smart mug. Independent evaluations in two external laboratories using additional primer-template systems, including DNA targets, further supported suppression of nonspecific amplification and sequence-dependent target detection. Together, these findings support TrueLAMP as a practical approach for improving the reliability of LAMP detection while retaining a simple isothermal workflow.

rising.title: The first chromosome-scale genome assembly of Blumeria graminis f. sp. avenae provides insights into genome evolution and host specialization
rising.title_zh: 第一个染色体级基因组组装燕麦白粉病菌（Blumeria graminis f. sp. avenae）提供了基因组进化和宿主特化的见解
rising.summary_zh: 燕麦白粉病菌（Bga），燕麦白粉病的病原体，是 B. graminis 物种复合体中最宿主特化的成员之一。尽管其农业重要性，缺乏高质量参考基因组限制了该病原体的宿主特化、毒力进化和比较基因组学研究。在这里，我们使用结合长读和短读测序、Hi-C 支架和转录组数据的集成方法生成了 Bga 的第一个染色体级基因组组装。Bga 基因组表现出白粉病真菌的标志性特征，包括广泛的重复内容和低基因密度。比较分析揭示，基因组扩张主要与历史转座子增殖相关，而非近期转座活动。基因组组织与功能分层的“单速”模型一致，其中与致病性相关的基因，包括预测效应子和感染响应基因，优先位于转座子丰富区域，其特征是减少的共线性保守性和扩展的基因间空间。相比之下，保守基因集中在紧凑基因组区域，并在感染谷物的专化型中保持强共线性保守性。Hi-C 分析证明了高度结构化的染色质架构，并揭示了与感染相关基因表达相关的基因组组织模式。比较

extra.description: Blumeria graminis f. sp. avenae (Bga), the causal agent of oat powdery mildew, is one of the most host-specialized members of the B. graminis species complex. Despite its agricultural importance, the lack of a high-quality reference genome has limited studies of host specialization, virulence evolution and comparative genomics in this pathogen. Here, we generated the first chromosome-scale genome assembly of Bga using an integrative approach combining long- and short-read sequencing, Hi-C scaffolding and transcriptome data. The Bga genome exhibits hallmark features of powdery mildew fungi, including extensive repeat content and low gene density. Comparative analyses revealed that genome expansion is primarily associated with historical transposable element proliferation rather than recent transpositional activity. Genome organization is consistent with a functionally stratified "one-speed" model, in which genes associated with pathogenicity, including predicted effectors and infection-responsive genes, are preferentially located in transposable element-rich regions characterized by reduced synteny conservation and extended intergenic spaces. In contrast, conserved genes are concentrated in compact genomic regions and maintain strong syntenic conservation across cereal-infecting formae speciales. Hi-C analyses demonstrated a highly structured chromatin architecture and revealed genome organization patterns associated with infection-related gene expression. Comparative genomic analyses indicated that host specialization in Bga is driven by localized diversification of a relatively small subset of genes rather than large-scale genome restructuring. These results provide the first high-quality genomic resource for Bga and offer new insights into the evolutionary mechanisms underlying host specialization in powdery mildew fungi.

rising.title: RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes
rising.title_zh: RegimeFormer：全局扰动机制的大型蛋白质模型
rising.summary_zh: 蛋白质语言模型在规模上组织序列和结构，但缺乏蛋白质如何响应突变的全局表示。我们提出了 RegimeFormer，一个大型蛋白质扰动模型，与 RegimeAtlas 耦合，通过协调和索引跨生命树的 202,556,313 个非冗余蛋白质序列构建。一个多样性保留的百万蛋白质子集提供高分辨率训练和推理层，其中 995,995 个蛋白质产生跨 407,048,356 个残基的残基级摘要，并按需提供替代特异性预测。跨实验深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束，RegimeFormer 识别可复现的蛋白质级扰动机制，组织残基脆弱性、适应性和预测不确定性。机制条件改善替代特异性预测，在未见蛋白质、未见家族和低同源性评估下获得最大相对增益。RegimeFormer 派生的分子先验进一步改善下游转录组和药物响应建模。RegimeFormer 和 RegimeAtlas 共同提供了一个可扩展框架，用于跨

extra.description: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.

new_today.summary_zh: 古都闲云的回答 看来贷款买房的人确实是少了，不然怎么会有这么多人不知道，实际可贷款期限和理论贷款期限根本是两回事呢？ 也不要觉得银行精于算计，从信用的角度卡贷款人年龄是必然的，毕竟个人办理房贷实际上也是信用派生的过程，那么凡是信用就可以计价。大到国家的信用可以发行一定规模的国债、发多了市场也不买账，小到个人的信用卡和消费贷也有不同的额度。 像房贷这种相对来说比较大额、在名义上有抵押物但实际偿还情况高度依赖于个人偿还能力的贷款，必然要考察贷款人的年龄。毕竟需要办理房贷的群体绝大多数都是工薪阶层，而对于绝大多数人来说，年龄和工资性收入的关系又是明摆着的。 而且实际办理房贷时可不只是只看贷款人年龄，还要看房产的年龄，毕竟以底线思维来说，一旦出现最极端的断供，银行方面还可以拿走抵押物，而众所周知房产是会折旧的，其他条件同等的情况下，房龄越老的房产可贷年限就越短，从实务层面一般房龄和贷款年限的和不会

new_today.title: Dynamic Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter: An Updatable Index for Large-Scale Fast Sequence Search
new_today.title_zh: 动态分层交错布隆过滤器：用于大规模快速序列搜索的可更新索引
new_today.summary_zh: 动机：测序成本的持续下降促进了可用测序数据的指数增长，像欧洲核苷酸档案库（ENA）和序列读取档案库（SRA）这样的公共数据库已达到 PB 量级。这激励了为常见生物信息学任务开发更可扩展的工具。其中一个任务是在参考数据集中近似搜索短序列模式，如基因或读取。近年来，已经提出了各种索引数据结构用于搜索大型测序数据库。最先进的索引，分层交错布隆过滤器（HIBF），是首个索引一百万个样本的同类工具。为了对扩展的存储库有用，它必须扩展以支持动态更新。结果：在本文中，我们通过扩展 HIBF 并采用部分重建来支持高效更新，引入了一种可扩展且可更新的序列搜索索引。我们通过迭代创建索引，从超过 100 TB 的压缩读取中跨越超过 39,000 个完整人类 RNA-Seq 样本，以 100 个连续批次更新，展示了动态 HIBF 的大规模数据能力。为了与最先进的工具进行基准测试，我们评估了 5,000 个样本子集

extra.description: Motivation: A continued decrease in sequencing costs has facilitated the exponential increase in available sequencing data, with public databases like the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) and Sequence Read Archive (SRA) reaching well in the order of petabases. This has been the incentive to develop more scalable tools for common bioinformatics tasks. One such task is the approximate searching of short sequence patterns like genes or reads in reference data sets. In recent years, a variety of indexing data structures have been proposed for searching large sequencing databases. The state-of-the-art index, the Hierarchical Interleaved Bloom Filter (HIBF) was first-in-class to index one million samples. To be useful for expanding repositories, it must be extended to support dynamic updates. Results: In this paper, we introduce a scalable and updatable sequence-search index by extending the HIBF with partial rebuilding to support efficient updates. We demonstrate the Dynamic HIBF's capacity for large-scale data by iteratively creating an index from over 100 TB of compressed reads across more than 39,000 full human RNA-Seq samples, updated in consecutive batches of 100. To benchmark against state-of-the-art tools, we evaluated incremental performance on a subset of 5,000 samples sub-sampled to 1% of their original read depth. In this comparative setting, the dynamic HIBF completed the sequential insertion of all 5,000 samples within 5 hours--24 to 65 times faster than competing methods and twice as fast as the static HIBF.

dropped.title: COBRA: Cell-type-specific Orthogonal Batch effect Removal Algorithm in single cell RNA-sequencing data.
dropped.title_zh: COBRA：单细胞RNA测序数据中细胞类型特异性正交批次效应去除算法。
dropped.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）能够高分辨率分析细胞异质性，但批次效应仍是数据整合中的关键挑战。现有批次校正方法通常假设批次效应在不同细胞类型间均匀，在降维空间中操作可能导致生物信息丢失，且需要大量计算资源。这里我们介绍COBRA，一种基于线性模型的批次校正方法，显式调整细胞类型特异性批次效应。通过将批次相关参数与生物变量正交化，COBRA去除技术伪影，同时保留有意义的转录差异。当细胞类型注释不可用时，COBRA实现迭代聚类算法来估计伪细胞类型，同时考虑批次效应。COBRA保留完整基因表达矩阵，确保下游分析无缝整合。我们在模拟和真实数据集（包括2型糖尿病和COVID-19数据集）上评估了COBRA。COBRA在批次混合效率、生物组结构保留和差异表达基因检测准确性方面表现更优。COBRA可在https://github.com/wonlab-healthstat/COBRA免费获取。复

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution profiling of cellular heterogeneity, yet batch effects remain a critical challenge in data integration. Existing batch correction methods often assume homogeneous batch effect across cell types, operate in reduced-dimensional space leading to potential loss of biological information, and require extensive computational resources. Here, we introduce COBRA, a linear model-based batch correction method that explicitly adjusts cell-type-specific batch effect. By orthogonalizing batch-associated parameters with respect to biological variables, COBRA removes technical artifacts while preserving biologically meaningful transcriptional differences. When cell type annotations are unavailable, COBRA implements an iterative clustering algorithm to estimate pseudo-cell types while accounting for batch effects. COBRA retains the full gene expression matrix, ensuring seamless integration for downstream analyses. We evaluated COBRA across simulated and real-world datasets, including type 2 diabetes and COVID-19 datasets. COBRA outperformed in terms of batch mixing efficiency, preservation of biological group structure, and accuracy of differentially expressed gene detection. COBRA is freely available at https://github.com/wonlab-healthstat/COBRA. The code to reproduce the analyses is archived at Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19891355). Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

dropped.title: Topologically-based parameter inference for agent-based model selection from spatiotemporal cellular data
dropped.title_zh: 基于拓扑的参数推断用于时空细胞数据的基于代理模型选择
dropped.summary_zh: 时空单细胞成像的进展使得详细观察细胞群体动态和细胞间相互作用成为可能。然而，将这些丰富数据集转化为机制洞察仍是重大挑战。基于代理模型（ABMs）是一种自下而上的计算框架，用于研究由单个相邻细胞间相互作用规则产生的细胞群体涌现行为，而拓扑数据分析（TDA）提供空间组织的稳健描述符。我们提出TOPAZ（基于拓扑的参数推断用于基于代理模型优化），一个将TDA与近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）、近似近似贝叶斯计算（AABC）和贝叶斯模型选择相结合的计算流程，从时空细胞数据中识别生物学合理的ABMs。TOPAZ使用持续同调量化细胞轨迹的空间特征，并通过ABC和AABC结合拓扑信息进行参数推断，使用贝叶斯信息准则进行模型比较。我们使用成纤维细胞集体运动模拟验证TOPAZ，展示其准确恢复模型参数并区分基线ABM和包含对齐相互作用的扩展模型的能力。我们的结果和开源代码展示了TOPAZ作为空间单细胞分析中机制推断和

extra.description: Advances in spatiotemporal single-cell imaging have enabled detailed observations of cell population dynamics and intercellular interactions. However, translating these rich data sets into mechanistic insight remains a significant challenge. Agent-based models (ABMs) are a bottom-up computational framework for investigating the emergent behavior of cell populations that can arise from rules defining the interactions between individual neighboring cells, while topological data analysis (TDA) provides robust descriptors of spatial organization. We present TOPAZ (TOpologically-based Parameter inference for Agent-based model optimiZation), a computational pipeline that integrates TDA with approximate Bayesian computation (ABC), approximate approximate Bayesian computation (AABC), and Bayesian model selection to identify biologically plausible ABMs from spatiotemporal cellular data. TOPAZ uses persistent homology to quantify spatial features of cell trajectories and combines this topological information with parameter inference via ABC and AABC and model comparison using the Bayesian information criterion. We validate TOPAZ using simulations of collective fibroblast movement, demonstrating its ability to accurately recover model parameters and distinguish between a baseline ABM and an extended model that incorporates an alignment interaction. Our results and open-source code demonstrate the utility of TOPAZ as an extensible framework for mechanistic inference and model discrimination in spatial single-cell analysis.
